title: Update `Starlette` dependency >= 1.01
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Upgrade Starlette dependency to >= 1.01.



### Why?

The Starlette version locked by pyproject.toml has not been remediated from a critical vuln (CVE-2026-48710 'BadHost'). 

### How?

Upgrade version and correct any issues this may cause.

### Additional Context

_No response_

Hi [USER], I'd like to work on this. I'll update the Starlette dependency constraint in pyproject.toml to >= 1.01 and check for any compatibility issues the version bump may introduce.

Starlette `1.01` is allowed by Streamlit and will be installed if no other dependency requires an older version; we only pin a minor version to allow a broad set of technical compatibility. It is up to the app developer to ensure that the latest versions of the dependencies are installed.
[USER] i had a report from a user that 1.01 wasn't compatible currently, but I do get version 1.2.1 in the devcontainer :-)
